title: Running from the Right Folder
objective: Create a lesson-runner folder in the practice folder, move into it, and print the folder name.
hint: New-Item with -ItemType Directory, -Force, and -Path for C:\Development\ps-practice\lesson-runner, then | Out-Null. Then Set-Location to that same full path. Then Write-Output with Working in: and $(Split-Path -Path (Get-Location).Path -Leaf).
